name: thingsctl
description: Things 3 in ChatGPT and Codex, with a local task workspace and verified commands.

interface.longDescription: A Things-inspired app in the ChatGPT sidebar and conversation panel. Browse and edit Things 3 with list navigation, Quick Entry, separate When and Deadline controls, projects, areas, tags, and selected-task context. Runs on your Mac through the ThingsCTL Bridge.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan today using Things.
